atoms.a: What’s the difference between a coordinating conjunction and a subordinating conjunction?
b: ++A coordinating conjunction connects two independent clauses, while a subordinating conjunction connects an independent and a dependent clause.
A subordinating conjunction connects two dependent clauses, while a coordinating conjunction connects two independent clauses.
